 CMF Speaker S and Speaker M Malaysia: Pre-order price starts from RM259
 BY 
 Janarrthine Kannan 
 28 October 2026 
 4:33 pm 
 Comment 
 Share on Facebook Share on Twitter 
 CMF by Nothing has officially launched its first portable Bluetooth speakers in Malaysia , introducing the compact CMF Speaker S and the larger CMF Speaker M. 
 Adopting an upright silhouette inspired by beverage cartons, both wireless speakers are now available for pre-order nationwide ahead of their official open sale.
 CMF Speaker S and Speaker M Malaysia price and availability
 Here are the official retail prices for both speakers:
 Speaker S: RM259
 Speaker M: RM459
 Pre-orders are officially open starting 28 October 2026, with nationwide open sales commencing on 3 November 2026.
 Both models come in four colourways, namely White, Dark Grey, Orange, and Turquoise. 
 Customers can place pre-orders online through the official nothing.tech Malaysia store , as well as official brand channels on Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop. 
 Offline retail units will be available through the Nothing Image Store, Urban Republic, TMT, and other authorised dealers.
 CMF Speaker S specs, features, and audio
 The CMF Speaker S measures 130.5mm tall, 85mm wide, and 44mm thick with an overall weight of 334g. 
 Built for grab-and-go portability, its chassis includes an integrated corner attachment point for carabiners and straps. It also features swappable front panels and dials, support for 3D-printed custom parts, and an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.
 Audio is driven by a custom-tuned 45mm full-range driver and dual passive radiators, delivering 10W RMS output across a 70Hz to 20kHz frequency range. 
 Its 2,600mAh battery provides up to 18 hours of playback at 50 percent volume with Ultra Bass enabled, with a 10-minute USB-C charge yielding one hour of listening time. 
 A full recharge takes 2.5 hours. Connectivity options include Bluetooth 6.0, NFC tap-to-pair, Google Fast Pair, Microsoft Swift Pair, dual-device pairing, low-latency USB-C wired audio under 60ms, Stereo Mode, and Auracast Party Mode.
 CMF Speaker M specs, features, and audio
 The larger CMF Speaker M measures 220mm tall, 85mm wide, and 54mm thick, weighing 602g. Instead of a corner loop, it adds an integrated carrying handle built directly into the top of the chassis .
 The main upgrade is its acoustic hardware, stepping up to a 35W RMS dual-driver setup comprising a dedicated 25W 70mm woofer and a 10W 16mm tweeter. This arrangement extends bass response down to 60Hz up to 20kHz, delivering significantly deeper low end and clearer vocal separation. 
 To support the higher power output, the Speaker M packs a 4,900mAh battery that matches the smaller model with up to 18 hours of playback, taking 3 hours to recharge fully over USB-C. 
 It retains all key features from the Speaker S, including IP68 water resistance, modular faceplates, Bluetooth 6.0 with Auracast, USB-C audio, and Nothing X app customisation.
